responsibility: This header defines the `cortexa35_tunings` model for Arm Cortex-A35 in the AArch64 backend. It largely reuses Cortex-A53 cost components where appropriate but packages the issue rate, fusion capabilities, alignment, and generic vector and prefetch policies into the `tune_params` structure that drives backend costing, scheduling, and code-shape heuristics for `-mtune=cortex-a35`.
